title: GROMACS Protein MD
description: Protein-ligand molecular dynamics simulation with GROMACS, GAFF2 ligand parameterisation, and MM-PBSA/GBSA binding free energy.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

force_field.description: Protein force field. amber99sb-ildn is the most validated for protein folding and MD.
force_field.help_text: CHARMM36m (Best et al., 2012) is preferred for IDPs and membrane proteins.

water_model.description: Explicit water model. Must be compatible with the chosen force field.

gaff_version.description: GAFF ligand force field. gaff2 improves torsion parameters over gaff.

box_padding.description: Minimum distance (Å) from protein atoms to box edge.

ion_concentration.description: NaCl concentration (mol/L) for system neutralisation. 0.15 M is physiological.

pressure.description: Pressure in bar for NPT ensemble.

n_steps.description: Number of MD steps. 5,000,000 × 2 fs dt = 10 ns production run.

nstxout_compressed.description: Write compressed trajectory frame every N steps (5000 × 2 fs = 10 ps interval).

mmgbsa_startframe.description: Skip first N frames for MM-GBSA (equilibration buffer).

mmgbsa_endframe.description: Last frame for MM-GBSA analysis. -1 = use all frames.

mmgbsa_interval.description: Analyse every Nth frame for MM-GBSA.

gpu.description: Enable GPU-accelerated GROMACS kernels. Strongly recommended for production runs.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.
